title: The Great Steak
lines: Mom set a great steak on a plate.
"Do not break this plate," he said.
Tom took the plate to the table.
He did not see the cat on the mat.
Tom fell. The plate did break.
The cat ate that great steak up.
Tom did the dishes for a week.

questions.listenFor: He did not see the cat on the mat. It is in the fourth line.

questions.ask: Who got to eat the steak?
questions.listenFor: The cat. Kids often love this one.

questions.ask: Was doing the dishes fair? Why or why not?
questions.listenFor: Either side is fine. You want the reason they give.
